erratum: SRCTF v1 — separate data spending from evidential validity; strengthen the naming guard; define the degenerate-correlation case

repair_1_spent_data_is_not_valid_evidenc.the_defect_in_erratum_01: it said a bug discovered after the qualification block is consumed cannot retroactively invalidate the attempt. That correctly blocks shopping for a do-over, but it over-corrected: it would license reporting a KNOWN software defect's output as a scientific finding.
repair_1_spent_data_is_not_valid_evidenc.the_concrete_failure_it_would_have_produ: the scanner consumes the block, returns NO_REVERSAL, and a deterministic unit test afterwards proves INTERCEPTOR never received its target coordinates. That result is not evidence that the environment lacks demand -- it is evidence about the bug.
repair_1_spent_data_is_not_valid_evidenc.the_separation: data spending and evidential validity are independent. Consuming a block is irreversible; interpreting its output as evidence is conditional on the execution being sound.

INVALID_ATTEMPT.when: a verified plumbing, identity, or reachability failure is detected BEFORE the qualification block is consumed

INVALID_EXECUTION.when: a verified, previously-undetectable implementation failure is proven AFTER the block is consumed
INVALID_EXECUTION.design: gets NO rerun on this benchmark version
INVALID_EXECUTION.may_report: nothing scientific. The design closes as INCONCLUSIVE.
INVALID_EXECUTION.why_both_prohibitions: a PASS would reward a bug; a NO_REVERSAL would let a defect masquerade as a property of the environment. Both are false, in opposite directions.

VALID.when: reachability preconditions passed first and no implementation failure is subsequently proven
VALID.outcome: the result stands as evidence, PASS or FAIL, and closes the design either way

anti_abuse_retained_and_tightened.burden_of_proof: INVALID_EXECUTION requires a DETERMINISTIC, reproducible demonstration -- a failing unit test or an equivalent artifact -- that the defect made the measured quantity not the intended quantity. Recorded in the artifact with the test.
never_sufficient: a defect that does not change what was measured
anti_abuse_retained_and_tightened.the_asymmetry_is_deliberate: an INCONCLUSIVE close is strictly worse for the experimenter than a clean FAIL -- it costs the block AND yields no finding. Nobody gains by reaching for it.

repair_2_naming_guard_strengthened.the_defect: canonicalize_opponent_key(name) == name is necessary but not sufficient. Depending on how the canonicalizer treats unknown strings, an identity result could also be returned for a name that resolves through nothing at all.
required_conjunction_all_must_hold: name in SRCTF_CANONICAL_OPPONENTS (an explicit registry, membership asserted)
trajectory_hash(name) == the frozen expected behaviour hash
repair_2_naming_guard_strengthened.why_the_registry_must_be_explicit: membership makes the intended set a first-class object rather than an emergent property of string handling. Without it, a typo can canonicalize to itself and look valid.
repair_2_naming_guard_strengthened.why_the_last_two_matter_most: C6 proved that a profile can resolve perfectly, report correct knobs, pass every identity check, and still never reach the simulator. Name-level correctness and behavioural reachability are different properties.
repair_2_naming_guard_strengthened.no_synonym_layer: reaffirmed. No SRCTF opponent may appear in OPPONENT_SYNONYMS or OPPONENT_ALIASES.

repair_3_degenerate_correlation.the_gap: the capacity rule assumed Pearson r is defined. It is undefined when offensive_pressure or red_contest_fraction has zero variance across the population.
repair_3_degenerate_correlation.the_frozen_rule: zero variance in EITHER probe variable -> AFFORDANCE_CAPACITY_FAIL
repair_3_degenerate_correlation.rationale: an environment in which every opponent allocates identically has demonstrably not expanded allocation diversity. A degenerate statistic is a failure, never a pass by default and never a skipped criterion.
repair_3_degenerate_correlation.also_covers: any case where r_bootstrap cannot be computed for the same reason; the bootstrap condition fails closed rather than being waived.

unchanged: the four dilemmas and the reward rule
the freeze point and the downstream gate sequence
SRCTF opponent names RAIDER, FORTRESS, ESCORT, SPLIT, INTERCEPTOR, ADAPTIVE
the decision not to relax the capacity bar if the CI proves demanding at this population size
immutability: After any SRCTF measurement exists, none of the above may change.
